scope: All five unchanged public native test commands on a fresh offline source-copy installation of stock IRIS AI Hub Build154U, followed by the literal public authenticated HTTP test inside that same disposable container. This is not a Dockerfile/Compose installer qualification or a hosted-viewer change.

source.private_transport_change: Public host runners used a guarded docker transport shim. Each session forced the pinned private daemon, unique Compose project and exact disposable container ID; raw native stdout/stderr were retained. The container was created directly with Compose discovery labels, including its computed service config hash, rather than by Compose up.

installation.path: Frozen git archive copied into a new stopped stock container; pinned rfc8785 wheel installed with no-index/no-deps/require-hashes, Dockerfile PYTHONPATH/CPF settings, then exact public scripts/initialize.sh and initialize.script. No durable volume or ISC_DATA_DIRECTORY.
installation.standard_install_prerequisite_limitation: The existing private Docker engine has outer network mode none, no default route and no default bridge. Public Dockerfile pip download could not be exercised there; no build was attempted and no engine network/protection was changed.
